subject.title: Feature: Tool-level sandbox mode for selective isolation

question: Should OpenClaw support operator-selected per-tool host/sandbox placement, or keep sandboxing session-first with only tool-declared, narrowly audited gateway escapes?
rationale: Either direction changes the core trust boundary, plugin/tool registration contract, configuration surface, and the security meaning of sandboxed sessions; source inspection and the discussion do not establish maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt typed placement capabilities
options.body: Add a generic placement capability to tool registration plus an operator policy, with secure defaults and explicit prompt-injection threat-model tests.

options.title: Keep session-first sandboxing
options.body: Retain one sandbox boundary per session and allow only narrowly defined tool-owned gateway operations through an audited privilege mechanism.

options.title: Reject mixed-trust sessions
options.body: Treat sessions that consume untrusted external content as wholly sandboxed and document subagents or separate agents as the supported isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt typed placement capabilities
recommendation.body: Add a generic placement capability to tool registration plus an operator policy, with secure defaults and explicit prompt-injection threat-model tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and feature history most strongly connect this person to the cross-cutting sandbox and tool-routing decision surface.
